name: James Hakurazaki
original_name: ジェームス 羽倉崎
source:
Second-year student. Assistant Vice President, in charge of external affairs.
He seems to be of mixed race, but the details are unknown. He does have striking features, though. It's possible he's just calling himself James.
His personality is Latin.
Along with [url=/c67907]Seseragi Sanshirou[/url], he single-handedly handles all the suspicious activities within the student council.

[From the [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/voice/voice_03.html]official website[/url]]
